name: cae-viewpoint-report
description: Senior CAE review of a VCollab .cax or a native solver file (op2, odb, rst, d3plot, ...) delivered as three files: a viewpoint Markdown report, a CAX with rich PPT-style viewpoints (text, tables, charts, probes) and a WCAX with the same viewpoints. Native files are converted automatically with VMoveCAEBatch; everything runs with your local VCollab 26.1+ on Windows.

vcollab_dir.title: VCollab installation folder
vcollab_dir.description: Leave empty to auto-detect the newest C:\Program Files\VCollab\<version> folder.
